two_finger_gesture.boundary: Fixture drop_success=false here refers to the separate single-pointer drop target, not a failure of the two-pointer chain. No claim of map/gallery pinch or rotation acceptance.

workspace_round_trip.boundary: One small synthetic file through the existing file protocol; no physical SAF grant/provider, large or multiblock transfer, interrupted transfer, storage-budget or cleanup test in this run.

retained_failures_and_recovery.recovery: New observations established current fixture state before a subsequent gesture request. No blind replay was counted as success.
retained_failures_and_recovery.causation: Activity pause followed the CANCEL, but physical wake-lock/power-reason evidence is absent. The later screen lease fix does not by itself prove the cause of this cancellation.

retained_failures_and_recovery.recovery: A later fresh observation succeeded; unchanged test fields were checked. Failed capture did not authorize a tap.

evidence.review: Raw Muse replies were compared with post-action trees and local fixture-event analysis. Accepted responses alone were not treated as completion.
evidence.privacy: Original screenshots, scripts, configurations, service addresses, hardware/connection/request identifiers and raw logs remain private; this report contains synthetic test content and result summaries only.
